# β Pictoris b and c: GRAVITY relative astrometry

`gravity-2026.csv` is Table 1 of *The Hill sphere transits of β Pictoris c and the search for another 1981-like event* ([arXiv:2609.02708](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02708)), transcribed as printed: MJD, ΔRA and ΔDec from the star in mas with their errors, and the correlation ρ between them.

The rows are an independent check of `telescope associate`. The candidate orbits come from Lacour et al. 2021 ([arXiv:2109.10671](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.10671)), whose fit ended before these epochs, so none of the four rows was used to fit them. Each row should match its own planet and reject the star and the other planet.
